module_summary: AXI4 write-channel register slice: AW and B channels use simple bubble-inserting registers, W channel a two-entry skid buffer, each with registered valid/ready handshakes.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave AW valid; loaded into output AW valid register.

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: Slave AW ready from registered early-ready of AW slice.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address captured into AW output register.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Master AW valid driven from AW valid register.

anchors.name: m_axi_awready
anchors.why: Master AW ready clears AW output valid.

anchors.name: genblk1.store_axi_aw_input_to_output
anchors.why: Loads all AW fields from slave inputs into output registers.

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave W valid into skid buffer output or temp slot.

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: Slave W ready from registered skid-buffer early ready.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data captured into output or temp register.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Registered write data output of the W skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Master W valid from output valid register.

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: Master W ready decides direct transfer vs temp storage and early ready.

anchors.name: genblk2.temp_m_axi_wdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp slot holding W data when master stalls.

anchors.name: genblk2.temp_m_axi_wvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp slot occupied flag; gates early ready and temp-to-output move.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_w_input_to_output
anchors.why: Loads W input directly into output registers.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_w_input_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads W input into temp skid registers when output stalled.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-response valid from B register.

anchors.name: s_axi_bready
anchors.why: Slave B ready clears registered response valid.

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Master B valid loaded into slave response register.

anchors.name: m_axi_bready
anchors.why: Master B ready from registered early ready.

anchors.name: s_axi_bresp
anchors.why: Registered write response code to slave.

anchors.name: genblk3.store_axi_b_input_to_output
anchors.why: Loads B response fields into slave-side registers.

groups.name: AW register slice
groups.description: Simple register for write address channel with bubble cycles.

groups.name: W skid buffer
groups.description: Output plus temp registers giving full-throughput W channel.

groups.name: B register slice
groups.description: Simple register for write response channel.
